name: Akiha College
description: Akiha College is an editorial WordPress theme built for an electrical apprenticeship college, featuring a framed hero window and docked navigation. Grounded in quiet monochrome tones and robust serif typography, it structures apprentice portfolio cases, practical assessment milestones, and employer routes with calm clarity. Designed for rigorous vocational presentation, it reflects authentic workshop standards and documented craftsmanship established in Calder Quay since 1998.

fonts.role: display: the home question, section headings, case names, row titles, figures and the wordmark (variable 400 and 500, Latin subset, with italic)
text: body copy, navigation, labels, captions (variable 400 to 700, Latin subset, with italic)
display for Traditional Chinese (zh-TW) pages: headings and the wordmark (Regular 400, subset to the zh-TW sample text; never a Japanese font)
